notes.title: Meet update 20012025!
notes.content:
Hi all! Here comes the new year 2025! A quarter of the 21st century has passed! Yes, there are no flying cars outside the window, and people do not live on other planets (and it is unlikely that they will). But still! The future is still unpredictable! And may it bring us hope and light! And here I am bringing you another update :)

So! Its composition:

- A new unit with unique logic, Prometheus, is a mobile weather control device, and depending on the cloudiness you can direct charges.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34368065/682de2b2779392d6b3d48f7b171ff02bbe185336.gif[/img]

- New achievement for being hit by lightning :)

- IMPORTANT! Now players can select the type of their graphics card in the settings (NVIDIA\AMD)

- Added more options for combinations of rain/heavy rain, and to them combinations of thunder and lightning
- Fixed synchronization of weather effects over the network
- Added side lights to the CADA Cityline bus and changed the turn signals
- All engineering vehicles have a speed gradation to make it easier for you to “park” them next to destroyed units
- Fixed a collision of the bar counter in the Winter Ashes tavern
- The siren of the CADA CRISTINE car in the police version has been corrected
- The side lights of the Millennia A1\Millennia A2 car have been fixed and the brake lights have been transferred. And lamps have been added to the interior.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34368065/1ddfa0da4dbf59fd116498ed473e9f60b4f92d7f.png[/img]

- The Minotaur unit’s carry logic has been corrected
- All engineering vehicles have a slightly increased crane operating radius
- Fixed self-healing for engineering vehicles
- Corrected the model of the Angara SAM

The next step is the processing of infantry for the network game. And the development of new maps.
